title: 🦠 New Malware Uses AI to Secretly Click on Ads!
body: 🦠 New Malware Uses AI to Secretly Click on Ads!

Security researchers spotted new Android malware that uses machine learning to identify ads and click on them automatically, through a hidden browser window the user never sees, aiming to generate fake ad revenue. The malware spreads mainly through ordinary games in alternative app stores and outside file-download platforms. Users may notice faster battery drain and higher data usage, and experts warn that the malware itself could later be used for threats more serious than ad fraud.
Simply put: the malware works in secret inside your phone and clicks on ads you never see, so the attackers earn money from fake clicks while you pay the price in battery and data.
Do you download apps from outside the official store?
